name: Angry Neighbor VR: Sneak & Survive
summary: Sneak into your angry neighbor's house, complete secret missions, and escape before getting caught! Angry Neighbor: Sneak & Survive is a thrilling VR stealth adventure where every step matters. Explore the house, solve puzzles, complete tricky tasks, hide from your neighbor, and make a quick escape when danger arrives. Can you finish your mission without being discovered? Test your sneaking skills and survive the challenge in this exciting VR adventure!
